purpose: Snapshot revisions resolved in the measurement machine's Hugging Face cache, captured before that cache was considered for cleanup. Several of these were pinned nowhere else in this repository; the cache directory was their only record.
method: Read from ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/<repo>/snapshots/<revision> and cross-checked against ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/<repo>/refs/main on <user>@<host>.
notes: Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B agree with the parent_revision fields in parent_manifest.json, parent8b_manifest.json and both checkpoint_manifest_v2 files.

Salesforce/wikitext at b08601e0... is the prompt-set source, pinned in harness/make_prompts.py (split=test, gpt2 tokenizer, 320-token non-overlapping chunks, 64 prompts) which produced calib_prompts.json.

garage-bAInd/Open-Platypus at 37141edb... is the llm-compressor calibration set used by both quantization recipes. This revision was pinned nowhere in the repository before this file: checkpoint_manifest_v2 records the dataset only as 'open_platypus (llmcompressor builtin; revision unrecorded at quantization time -- honest gap)'. Recording it here does not retroactively make it a pre-registered pin; the paper's Limitations statement about the calibration-dataset revision stands unchanged.
gpt2 is the tokenizer used for prompt chunking only, not for any model under test.
The two RedHatAI entries are 12 KB metadata-only stubs from an early survey of published w8a8/FP8 checkpoints; no measurement in this study used them.
